goal: Fast calendar plus captions for a 1–2 week Facebook push (Page Feed and Reels). Calendar and caption skills are Instagram-oriented in copy; edit Data for Facebook tone and CTAs.

milestones.title: Facebook sprint brief
milestones.goal: Define sprint window, Facebook surfaces, and cadence before calendar and captions.
milestones.data:
## Facebook sprint brief

**Sprint start date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**Sprint end date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**Theme or angle:** <!-- e.g. Happy hour small plates -->
**Featured item(s) or category:** <!-- comma-separated -->
**Facebook surfaces:** <!-- Page Feed, Facebook Reels, Stories -->
**Post cadence:** <!-- e.g. 1 Feed + 1 Reel per day -->
**Page CTA:** <!-- e.g. Reserve via link in bio / Call now -->
**Notes:** <!-- tone, compliance, no alcohol claims, etc. -->

passCriteria.requirement: Sprint end date is specified and is on or after the start date.
Featured item(s) or a clear theme is stated.
At least one Facebook surface is named.
Post cadence is noted (e.g. posts per day or per week).

milestones.title: Campaign calendar
milestones.goal: Compact calendar for the sprint; after Prepare, ensure slots are labeled for Facebook Feed vs Reels vs Stories.

passCriteria.requirement: Calendar covers the full sprint window from the Facebook sprint brief.
Each slot includes format and at least one featured menu item by name.
Each slot includes a caption angle and intended Facebook surface.

milestones.title: Caption batch
milestones.goal: Publish-ready captions; adjust for Facebook (slightly longer OK, clear CTA, Page-appropriate hashtags).

passCriteria.requirement: Every calendar slot has a caption.
Each caption opens with a hook (first line).
Each caption includes a CTA aligned with the sprint brief.
Tags or hashtags are included where useful for Facebook discovery.
